title: All We Needed After 9/11 Was A Closed Border
text:
Since 9/11, America has imported 1.8 million Muslims into the country from 2001 to 2024.

In order to prevent another 9/11, the only policy the American government needed to pursue was closing down the borders and never allowing Third-Worlders into the country again. Politicians not only refused to do that, but actually did the opposite.

Instead, Americans got stuck with a mass surveillance state, two forever wars, the importation of countless Third-Worlders, and the Transportation Security Administration (TSA), which to date has never stopped a terror attack, but has made Americans’ travel experience miserable. Americans, in other words, got a major reshuffling of their constitutional rights in favor of government power, and a homeland that quickly became unrecognizable.

Just six days after the most deadly terror attack on American soil in history, President George W. Bush made a hajj to the Islamic Center of Washington, D.C, where he proclaimed that the very people who just murdered 2,977 innocents in New York, Pennsylvania, and Virginia are peaceful.

“These acts of violence against innocents violate the fundamental tenets of the Islamic faith. And it’s important for my fellow Americans to understand that,” Bush said in a speech titled “Islam is Peace” on Sept. 17, 2001. “The face of terror is not the true faith of Islam. That’s not what Islam is all about. Islam is peace. These terrorists don’t represent peace.”

Bush went on a campaign to make sure no American blamed Islam for the attack. He repeated the message in the Oval Office on Sept. 19 and to a Joint Session of Congress on Sept. 20. That same day he claimed that Muslim terrorists were trying to “hijack Islam itself,” an assertion he repeated on Oct. 11, 2002, and numerous other times in various forms.

His Nov. 15, 2001, Ramadan message attempted to advance the “the terrorists hate you for your freedom” message, stating, “This new enemy seeks to destroy our freedom and impose its views. We value life; the terrorists ruthlessly destroy it. We value education; the terrorists do not believe women should be educated or should have health care, or should leave their homes. We value the right to speak our minds; for the terrorists, free expression can be grounds for execution. We respect people of all faiths and welcome the free practice of religion; our enemy wants to dictate how to think and how to worship even to their fellow Muslims.”

He carried this message all the way through the end of 2002 and beyond.

And he meant it. In an effort to make sure he could not be subjected to claims of “Islamophobia,” he started importing Muslims by the millions into American communities.

Since 9/11, America has imported 1.8 million Muslims into the country from 2001 to 2024, a 103 percent increase compared to the 58 percent increase in foreign-born population in the same timeframe. The increase represents growth that is 700 percent faster than that of the total U.S.-born population, according to the Center for Immigration Studies (CIS). Those importations do not take into account the countless children those migrants have had inside the country, who are legally considered American citizens.

The cultural change in the United States has been palpable. There are entire cities overrun by Muslims, creating de facto Islamic enclaves like Dearborn, Michigan, represented by Rep. Rashida Tlaib, D-Mich.; Hamtramck, Michigan, which has a fully Muslim-run city council and police chief; Paterson, New Jersey, which has multiple Muslims on the city council; Minneapolis, Minnesota, the American headquarters of Somali Muslim scammers; and New York City, which recently elected a foreign-born socialist Muslim mayor using the countless foreigners, including 1.5 million Muslims, who have been imported there.

Because there are so many more Muslims, it is impossible to go to a grocery store in many urban areas or suburbs without being required to purchase halal meats, because they are the only options. National Parks and malls have turned into a sea of burka-clad women following behind their husbands single-file. In some areas, like many outside Washington, D.C., hearing English throughout the day at all is a rarity.

On top of the demographic change, Americans found themselves subject to a new regime defined by the mass surveillance system put in place by the USA PATRIOT Act and an updated FISA Court system, entirely destroying the Fourth Amendment.

As National Security Agency whistleblower Edward Snowden revealed to the public, mass collection of Americans’ metadata was being conducted by the federal government, with zero warrants. These changes paved the way for the current Flock camera debate.

Locking down the border, at least to Muslims, is all the American government had to do in response to 9/11. But globalist neocons, who both believe in mass migration as a policy matter and were also afraid of being called racist, used the tragedy to completely undermine American culture and society.
